corrections.decision: Signed 1D force versus magnitude, elastic range, stiffness units.
Initial velocity sign retained; zero-amplitude phase undefined.
Viscous versus Coulomb; zeta0 is undamped endpoint.
Critical nonoscillatory does not prohibit single crossing for arbitrary initial velocity; explicit counterexample.
Output velocity derivative is not universally error derivative for moving targets; PID integral role conditional.
Source SprintDamper typo corrected to SpringDamper; new-velocity update semi-implicit and conditionally stable.
Mass-normalized versus physical coefficients distinguished; frequency units explicit.
First-order decay sign corrected; exact update requires fixed target during interval.
